benefits.subtitle: Everything you need for a successful nursing career — in one place

feed.proTipBody: Keep your profile updated with certifications and experience so jobs and colleagues can find you faster.
feed.aboutCardTeaser: The story behind our professional network.
feed.aboutStoryP1: She left high-tech — screens, deadlines, back-to-back meetings — to pursue a career as a nurse.
feed.aboutStoryP2: A nursing student applied for a position and learned her CV had to be printed and handed in person to the head nurse responsible for hiring. That revealed a gap that must be addressed to move nursing one step further forward.
feed.aboutStoryP3: NurseLinks was born: a closed professional network for nurses to share from the ward, find jobs, build connections, and strengthen nursing in Israel. A community that moves the profession forward.
feed.composerModalPlaceholder: Share an update, a story from your ward, or a photo from work..

legal.title: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy
legal.p1: To use the platform, it is important to know that personal information you enter on the site (such as name, contact details, professional details, and content you choose to publish) is stored and processed for operating the service, improving user experience, and maintaining a secure and reliable system.
legal.p2: By approving during registration, you confirm that you have read and understood the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, and that you agree to the storage and processing of your information according to this policy.
legal.p3: You can review the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy at any time through this page.
